fact: From 19 to 21 May 2026, 30 technical staff of five Niger public bodies (HACP, MISPAT, ANSI, CASEFSE, Ministry of Finance) were trained in Power BI data analysis in Niamey under the UN-supported ILLIMI project.
title: Power BI : 30 cadres nationaux formés pour améliorer la prise de décision guidée par les données
